explainer_content.short_definition: Groove-first soul music where rhythm, bass, and band hits become the main event.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Funk grew from soul and R&B by pushing syncopation, bass, drums, and collective groove to the front, then expanded through psychedelic soul and cosmic stagecraft.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It became a foundation for disco, hip-hop sampling, dance music, and modern R&B rhythm.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The groove does not support the song; the groove is the song.
